program_description: The Agriculture sector - composed of the DA, its attached agencies and corporations, PCIC and the DAR - will receive a much-needed unprecedented boost of 39.2 percent year-on-year and receive a budget of Php 184.1 billion.

source_location: Achieving the 8-point Socioeconomic Agenda narrative
program_description: For 2023, we have allocated Php 13.1 billion for the construction, rehabilitation, and repair of farm-to-market roads across the country. source_location: Achieving the 8-point Socioeconomic Agenda narrative

source_location: Achieving the 8-point Socioeconomic Agenda narrative
program_description: To ensure the equitable and sustainable development of our agriculture and fisheries sector through the continued implementation of the Agriculture and Fisheries Modernization Program, Php 5.9 billion has been apportioned for the construction of agricultural facilities and the procurement of machineries, as well as on-farm and post-harvest facilities/equipment. source_location: Achieving the 8-point Socioeconomic Agenda narrative

source_location: Achieving the 8-point Socioeconomic Agenda narrative

source_location: Achieving the 8-point Socioeconomic Agenda narrative

program_name: Strategic programme on strengthening the nation's principal institutions
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to instill everyone in the nation a conscience to cherish and treasure, maintain loyalty and uphold the nation's principal institutions. This can be done by protecting, maintaining and upholding the monarchy, providing safety to the monarchy and the royal family, mobilizing area development along the royal initiatives and the Philosophy of Sufficiency Economy, as well as giving support to the royal special activities.

program_name: Strategic programme on maintaining internal peace
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocating to create security and safety in life and belongings for the people by maintaining internal peace and domestic security. Emphasis will be made on cultivating a conscience and awareness on unity and promoting solidarity of people in the nation.

program_name: Strategic programme on developing and strengthening politics in the democratic regime with the monarchy as head of state
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to create a higher level of political stability and governance by promoting public relations to develop politics and government under the democratic regime. People's engagement in politics, to create knowledge, understanding, faith and awareness as a good citizen under the democratic regime with the monarchy as head of state will be promoted.

program_name: Integrated programme on mobilization of problem rectification of southern border provinces
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to support the integrated efforts in protecting and solving the violence in the southern border provinces on a systematic and solidified approach. Public participation will be promoted to create understanding among the people both within and outside of the southern border provinces.

program_name: Strategic programme on management of problems of alien workforce and human trafficking
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to enable the victims of human trafficking, child labour, forced labour and vulnerable groups to be systematically protected by providing the target groups with knowledge and understanding on the problems of human trafficking and capability to protect themselves from the said activities. Victims of human trafficking will be protected and welcome back to the society.

program_name: Integrated programme on prevention, suppression and treatment of drug addiction
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to create immunity from narcotics for children, youth, workforce and vulnerable groups and for them to avoid getting involved with drugs by organizing mechanisms to systematically prevent, solve the problems and assist people. Emphasis will be given to suppression and apprehension of drug producers and traffickers, influential people and every public official involved in the drug business.

program_name: Strategic programme on preventing and rectifying problems with repercussions to the security
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to address the existing security problems for lasting solutions to the extent that there will be no further effects to the administration and development of the country. This can be achieved by developing an internal security maintenance and country development plan, preventing transnational threats and marine security, preventing and solving cyber security problems, and terrorisms.

program_name: Strategic programme on developing national preparedness system and disaster management system
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to improve reliability of emergency and rescue operations, as well as to minimize loss, and ensure safety in people's life and property. Effort will be made on improving operational capability and providing knowledge and awareness in order to be prepared in dealing with disaster management and improving efficiency.

program_name: Strategic programme on developing potentials in national defence and preparedness in coping with all forms of threats
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to prepare the armed forces and national security agencies in coping with all forms of threats at every dimenstion and every degree of severity. National preparedness system and plan will be developed to be modernized and deployable.

program_name: Strategic programme on development of mechanisms for security administration on a holistic approach
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to increase efficiency of security administrative mechanism. This will be done by promoting integration of security administrative mechanisms, enhancing preparedness and elevating security mechanism among agencies.

program_name: Strategic programme on promoting international relations
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to enable Thailand to have security and ability to cope with all forms of external challenges. This will also allows Thailand to become a sustainable development partner with other countries, and to be developed in harmony with international standards in every dimension.

program_name: Strategic programme on supporting national security
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to support strategic goals on security by enhancing capability of the administrative system, maintaining the country's cyber security, mobilizing protection and problem solving in accordance with the transpiring situtations in the localities.

source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to ensure efficient and cost effective administration of the missions on security and enabling public agencies to consistently perform and provide services according to the standard, authority and legal framework. It also covers taking good care of personnel, workplaces, equipments and working environment.

source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to ensure efficiency and cost effectiveness in the management of public sector personnel with regard to the government's operations. It also supports the development of work systems and improvement of personnel's competency in performing their duties with integrity and ethics while maintaining their work-life balance.

source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022

program_name: Strategic programme on value creation agriculture
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to enable expansion of the agricultural sector in the Gross Domestic Product, an increase in agricultural productivity and capability in processing products into high-value ones through value creation of agricultural products based on their potentials and uniquenesses. Technology will be applied to develop robust and sustainable agricultural resource bases.

program_name: Integrated programme on development of future industries and services
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to increase growth rate of the manufacturing sector in the Gross Domestic Product and increase manufacturing and service productivity throughout the supply chain. This can be achieved by promoting the food of the future industry on an integrated basis and creating the bio-industry economy, developing the medical services industry, promoting research and development and creating innovation.

program_name: Integrated programme on creating income from tourism
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to enable tourism as a mechanism in mobilizing the country's economy. The goal is to increase revenues from tourism which consequently increase its proportion in the total Gross Domestic Product by promoting domestic tourism, distributing tourism activities in term of areas and income to the communities as well as giving priority to the development of sustainable tourism.

program_name: Strategic programme on area development and smart livable city
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to improve Thailand's competitiveness by creating centers of economic and social prosperity in every region of the country and developing infrastructure for transportation, communication and energy systems with modern digital technologies. Economic and social prosperity will be distributed to elevate the cities' livability.

program_name: Integrated programme on development of transport and logistic system
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated for development of transport infrastructure and logistic system with comprehensive connectivity covering domestic and international routes leading to the enhancement of the country's competitiveness. Multimodal transport will be promoted in order to reduce logistic costs and increase the country's competitiveness.

program_name: Strategic programe on development of energy security
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to enable Thailand to have energy security and improve efficiency in the country's energy consumption. This can be achieved by promoting energy exploration, supporting development of energy infrastructure at an appropriate level, maintaining domestic production of crude oil and liquefied natural gas, diversifying appropriate types of energy and creating a system to cope with energy emergency situations.

program_name: Strategic programme on development of digital economy and society
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to increase economic value of digital businesses utilizing digital technology. This will be done through developing digital infrastructure with emphasis on the thorough internet coverage, elevating digital community and online learning centers, enabling people an access to data and services, promoting investment and utilization of common digital infrastructure resources.

program_name: Integrated programme on development of business operators and small and medium-sized enterprises
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to enable operators of small and medium-sized enterprises and community operators to have knowledge and skills for being entrepreneurs, ability to compete and possess innovation on creating business models, manufacturing process and service provision as well as digital and information technology skills and an access to domestic and international markets. Moreover, support will be given to capital acquisition which satisfies different operator's requirements and the expansion of trade and investment.

program_name: Strategic programme on development of special economic zones
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to develop the special economic zones as the centers of economic and social prosperity by providing infrastructure on communication, social, environment and education to the area, increasing efficiency of customs checkpoints and making proposals on new laws and regulations. Attention will be given to public relations focusing on both, Thai and international investors, to invest in the target areas.

program_name: Integrated programme on development of the Eastern Economic Corridor
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to promote modern and environmental-friendly economic activities, increase the country's competitiveness, develop efficient infrastructure and public utility system with continuity, accessibility, comprehensive and systematic connectivity. Emphasis will be made on development of attractive and livable cities with international modernity.

program_name: Strategic programme on innovation research and development
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to promote, support and mobilize the country's research and innovation system to create and support application of research and innovation findings for economic and social benefits leading to a balanced and sustainable development of the country. This will be achieved by encouraging both the public and private sectors to use research and innovation findings with emphasis on those being responsive to the country's needs.

program_name: Strategic programme on development of science, technology and innovation potentials
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to enable Thailand's development toward the society founded upon the knowledge-based economy. This can be achieved by developing infrastructure and amenities on science and modern technology, standards of quality system, and testing analysis accredited under the international agreements and in accordance with the current and future industry requirements.

program_name: Strategic programme on supporting the development of competitiveness
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to enable Thailand to achieve stable and sustainable economic growth by elevating the country's diverse potentials in the economy, identity, culture, tradition, way of life and natural resources as well as the country's other comparative advantages together with technology and innovation to be in harmony with the economic and social contexts of the modern world society. Emphasis will be given to the development of the country's various infrastructures.

program_name: Fundamental programme on the development of competitiveness
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to enable the efficiency and cost effectiveness in implementation of the country's competitiveness development allowing government agencies to operate and provide services on a continued basis with standard. Transport systems connecting infrastructure and amenities within the cities and regions and quality of public transport and traffic will be improved.

source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to ensure efficiency and cost effectiveness in the management of public sector personnel with regard to the government's operations along with the development of the work systems of government agencies. It also improves personnel's competency in performing their duties with integrity and ethics while maintaining their work-life balance.

source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022

program_name: Strategic programme on realignment of value and culture
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to enable Thai people to be of morality, value, respectable value with public conscience, responsibility to the society with patriotism and taking pride on the nation, religions and monarchy and adopting the Philosophy of Sufficiency Economy in daily life. In addition, communities and conservation of localities will be encouraged to promote and disseminate, develop and inherit arts and cultural heritage, local wisdom.

program_name: Strategic programme on development of human potentials on a life-long basis
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to enable Thai people of every age group to have physically, mentally, morally and the surroundings enhanced in terms of potentials which will contribute to security in life through promotion and development of children from infancy to early childhood for the age-based development with quality. Attention will be given to promote education and lifelong learning with quality, standard and necessary skills to accommodate living in the 21st century.

program_name: Strategic programme on development of education and learning quality
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to provide students, teachers, education personnel and the public to attain quality education conformed to national education standards by strengthening and developing learning systems responsive to every dimension of change and every age group in the 21st century. Emphasis will be made to a newly designed learning system, development of media and digital technologies, promotion of production and quality improvement of teachers and education personnel.

program_name: Strategic programme on good public health promotion
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Programme FY 2022
program_description: The amount will be allocated to enable people to attain good health and have access to a standard public health system by promoting the public health system reform emphasizing promotion of a thorough medical system, providing family doctors and Tambon health promotion hospitals. These measures will allow people in the communities to take care of their own health and the communities can be self-reliant on healthcare with sustainability.

program_name: Strategic Program on Strengthening the Nation's Principal Institutions
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to instill everyone in the nation a conscience to cherish and treasure, maintain loyalty and uphold the nation's principal institutions. This includes protecting, maintaining and upholding the monarchy, providing safety to the monarchy and the royal family, honoring core institutions and strengthening national identity, mobilizing area development along the royal initiatives and the Sufficiency Economy Philosophy, as well as giving support to the royal special activities.

program_name: Strategic Program on Maintaining Internal Peace
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to create security and safety in the citizens' lives and properties by maintaining internal peace and domestic security. Emphasis will be made on cultivating a conscience and awareness on unity, promoting solidarity of people in the nation, supporting the mission of the Territorial Defense Volunteers and Local Militias, strengthening crime prevention and suppression, enforcing laws, providing justice and services to the people, as well as creating public participation among all sectors.

program_name: Strategic Program on Developing and Strengthening Politics in the Democratic Regime with the Monarchy as Head of State
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to create political stability and good governance by promoting public relations to develop democracy, promoting public participation, and creating knowledge, understanding, and awareness of the good citizenship under the democratic regime with the monarchy as head of state.

program_name: Integrated Program on Mobilization of Problem Rectification of Southern Border Provinces
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to create national security, and safety in the citizens' lives and properties so that the people in the area are able to live together peacefully in a multicultural society. Support will be given to solve the problems and develop the southern border provinces by using an integrated system and unity covering all areas and target groups, including improving intelligence operations, creating understanding among the people, providing justice and remedying the victims, preventing illegal activities, and developing area potential in agriculture, infrastructure, and vocational and labor skills.

program_name: Strategic Program on Management of Problems of Alien Workforce and Human Trafficking
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to mobilize operations in the prevention of forced labor and human trafficking, and enable the victims of human trafficking, child labor, fishing labor, forced labor and risk groups to be systematically protected. Alien workforce will be provided with legitimate documents, cooperating networks will be created, and workplaces, risk groups, and labor will be inspected and protected from human trafficking while legal actions against cases are enhanced.

program_name: Integrated Program on Prevention, Suppression and Treatment of Drug Addiction
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to create immunity from narcotics for children, youth, workforce and risk groups, and for them to avoid getting involved with drugs. Emphasis will be given to organizing mechanisms to systematically prevent and solve the problems, suppress and arrest drug producers and traffickers, and provide treatment and rehabilitation to drug addicts through a systematic assistance and treatment system.

program_name: Strategic Program on Preventing and Rectifying Problems with Repercussions to the Security
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to address existing security problems for lasting solutions so that there will be no further effects to the administration and development of the country. This includes maintaining internal, border, and coastal security, safeguarding national marine interests, preventing and solving cyber security problems and terrorism, preventing transnational threats and maritime security, and developing capacity to deal with nuclear and radiation threats and emergencies.

program_name: Strategic Program on Developing National Preparedness System and Disaster Management System
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to improve reliability of emergency and rescue operations, minimize loss, and ensure safety in the citizens' lives and properties. Efforts will be made on improving operational capacity, providing equipment for disaster prevention and recovery, increasing disaster warning efficiency, training staff, and providing knowledge and awareness to the public.

program_name: Strategic Program on Developing National Defence Capacity and Preparedness in Coping with all Forms of Threats
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to prepare national security agencies to cope with all forms of threats. Attention will be made on increasing capacity of intelligence and anti-intelligence operations, enhancing the armed forces capacity in developing the country and assisting the people, and promoting and developing the national defense industry, military energy, along with research and development to support national defense.

program_name: Strategic Program on Developing a Holistic Security Administration Mechanism
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to increase efficiency of security management mechanism by promoting a holistic security mechanism to mobilize the National Security Policy and Plan.

program_name: Strategic Program on Promoting International Relations
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to enable Thailand to have security and ability to cope with all forms of external challenges, and to become a sustainable development partner with other countries in harmony with international standards. It will improve standards, promote economic and military relations and cooperation, enhance Thailand's image and role in the global community, and develop cooperation in science, technology and innovation partnership under international cooperation frameworks.

program_name: Strategic Program on Supporting National Security
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to support strategic goals on security by enhancing capacity of the national security management system, and supporting operations to prevent and solve problems from the situation in the southern border provinces.

source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to ensure efficient and cost-effective administration of the national security missions, and enable government agencies to consistently perform and provide services according to their authorities, legal frameworks, and the set standard, as well as taking good care of personnel, workplaces, equipment and work environment.

program_name: Strategic Program on Value Creation Agriculture
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to enable expansion of the Gross Domestic Product in the agricultural sector, increase agricultural productivity and capability in processing products into high-value ones by using technology to develop a robust and sustainable agricultural resource base. Emphasis will be made on research and development, strengthening farmers' livelihood via Income Guarantee Scheme, improving production toward safety standards, promoting added value for agricultural products, and creating new generation of farmers and farmers integration.

program_name: Integrated Program on Development of Future Industries and Services
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to increase growth rate of the Gross Domestic Product in manufacturing and services sectors, and increase productivity throughout the supply chain. This can be achieved by promoting bio-industry, developing high-technology entrepreneurs and labor, promoting research and development and innovation, supporting the utilization of intellectual property, and upgrading industries to high-technology industries.

program_name: Integrated Program on Creating Income from Tourism
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to enable tourism as a mechanism in mobilizing the country's economy by increasing revenue from tourism and investment in industry and services in the tourism sector. Attention will be placed on distributing tourism activities and income, focusing on sustainable tourism development, developing the whole tourism system with a focus on quality tourists, preserving the country's uniqueness, improving infrastructure and facilities, and building confidence in tourism safety.

program_name: Strategic Program on Area Development and Smart Livable City
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to improve Thailand's competitiveness by creating centers of economic and social prosperity in every region and developing transportation, communication and energy infrastructure with modern digital technologies. Economic and social prosperity will be distributed to elevate cities' livability, with support for city development databases, facilities and safety.

program_name: Integrated Program on Development of Transport and Logistic System
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to provide Thailand with efficient transportation and logistic systems, and reduce logistic costs leading to an increase in the country's competitiveness. Road, waterways, rail, and air transportation infrastructures and amenities will be developed, along with public transportation, logistics and supply chain management systems, trade facilitation, customs procedures, and international logistics networks.

program_name: Strategic Program on Development of Energy Security
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to enable Thailand to have energy security and improve efficiency in the country's energy consumption. Emphasis will be made on promoting renewable and alternative energy, improving efficiency of energy consumption in every sector, providing and developing stable energy infrastructure, supervising the energy market mechanism, restructuring energy prices, and revising laws and regulations.

program_name: Strategic Program on Development of Digital Economy and Society
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to increase value of digital businesses as a proportion of the Gross Domestic Product through developing digital infrastructure covering the main communication network and high-speed broadband network throughout the country. Attention will be placed on digital infrastructure, big data centers, privacy protection, personal data protection, cyber threat countermeasures, and providing people in every occupation with knowledge and skills on technology utilization.

program_name: Strategic Program on Supporting Strong and Competitive Small and Medium-sized Enterprises
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to encourage small and medium-sized enterprises and community entrepreneurs to have knowledge and skills of entrepreneurship with a clear identity, competitiveness and innovation. Supports will be given to the use of technology and innovation, financing, access to resources and knowledge, expansion of trade and investment, and adjustment of business models to meet market demand.

program_name: Strategic Program on Development of Special Economic Zones
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to develop the special economic zones as the center of economic and social prosperity by providing infrastructure on communication, social, environment and education, increasing efficiency of customs checkpoints and making proposals on new laws and regulations. Focus will also be on immigration services, border public health, communicable disease control, labor skills, foreign workers system, and border area development using digital technology and innovation.

program_name: Integrated Program on Development of the Eastern Economic Corridor
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to promote investments in the Eastern Economic Corridor. Emphasis will be put on supporting modern and environmental-friendly economic activities, developing efficient and connected infrastructure and public utility systems, developing attractive and livable cities, strengthening Thailand's role as the gateway to the Asian region, elevating deep-water ports and multi-purpose piers, and developing personnel competency to meet entrepreneurs' needs.

program_name: Strategic Program on Innovation Research and Development
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to enable the public and private sectors to apply the practical results of research and innovation development for economic and social benefits with an emphasis on research that is responsive to the country's needs. Focus will be placed on encouraging private sector engagement, developing standards and analytic testing services, and using research and innovation to support workforce development, resource conservation, pollution management and greenhouse gas management.

program_name: Strategic Program on Development of Science, Technology and Innovation Potentials
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to enable Thailand's development toward the society founded upon the knowledge-based economy. This can be achieved by developing infrastructure and amenities on science and modern technology, standards of quality system and testing analysis, and supporting technology transfer, research and development, engineering design, and process and product development through integration mechanisms between relevant agencies.

program_name: Strategic Program on Supporting Development of Competitiveness
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to support the strategic goal of developing the country's competitiveness to make Thailand a developed country with stable and sustainable economic growth. Emphasis will be given to elevating the country's potential in various dimensions, developing infrastructures, adjusting the environment to enhance entrepreneurs' potential, expanding trade and investment opportunities, and building income base and new employment.

program_name: Fundamental Program on Development of Competitiveness
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to enable efficiency and cost effectiveness in implementation of the country's competitiveness development allowing government agencies to operate and continuously provide quality public services. Attention will be placed on management of land and water resources, promoting trade, controlling product standards and prices, developing entrepreneurial potential, promoting marketing and tourism, maintaining transportation systems and amenities, and ensuring safe transport, travel and traffic.

program_name: Strategic Program on Development of Human Potentials on a Life-Long Basis
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used with a goal to improve every Thai people's life physically, mentally, and morally. Children and youth will have growth and appropriate skill development according to their age, education and life-long learning will be promoted, skill development for pupils and labor will be supported, and the elderly will be prepared to be self-reliant.

program_name: Strategic Program on Development of Education and Learning Quality
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to provide Thai people with quality and standard education system. Learning process will be reformed with regard to innovation and changes in the 21st century, teachers and education personnel will be equipped with academic and class management skills, and opportunities for vocational education and skill training will be expanded.

program_name: Strategic Program on Good Public Health Promotion
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to provide people with good health, increase access to standard public health services, and prepare for the outbreak of emerging and re-emerging diseases. Actions include promoting Village Public Health Volunteer mechanism, promoting Thai herbs and traditional medicine, training new doctors, nurses, and public health personnel, developing emergency medical and referral systems, and adopting digital technology to support medical service.

program_name: Strategic Program on Enhancing Sports Potentials
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2023
program_description: The budget will be used to ensure that Thai people will have good health. Emphasis will be made on promoting exercises, sports and recreational activities, cultivating sportsmanship and discipline, empowering national and youth athletes, developing sport and recreational personnel, and ensuring standard and quality sport science, infrastructure, equipment, and venues.

program_name: Strategic Program on Strengthening the Nation's Principal Institutions
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to foster loyalty, honesty, and commitment among Thai people to uphold the nation's principal institutions, and provide security to the King and royal family. This includes instilling awareness and appreciation of the significance of the nation's principal institutions, incorporating knowledge based on royal initiatives and the Sufficiency Economy Philosophy to develop and address regional problems, and supporting royal special activities.

program_name: Strategic Program on Maintaining Internal Peace
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to ensure security and safety for the public by enhancing the safety of lives and property and human security. The program focuses on supporting the mission of the Territorial Defense Volunteers and Local Militias, driving government policies using village mechanisms, increasing the efficiency of crime prevention and suppression operations and law enforcement, encouraging public participation from all sectors, and providing justice and services.

program_name: Strategic Program on Developing and Strengthening Politics in the Democratic Regime with the Monarchy as Head of State
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to enhance political stability and good governance by promoting the development and strengthening democratic politics. Focus will be on public relations for democracy development, public participation and network strengthening in the election process, and instilling in citizens the knowledge and understanding necessary to participate and fulfill their roles as good citizens within the democratic regime with the monarchy as head of state.

program_name: Integrated Program on Mobilization of Problem Rectification of Southern Border Provinces
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to bring peace to the southern region, ensure national security, and guarantee the safety of life and property for the people in the area, creating peaceful coexistence within a multicultural society. The strategy involves a systematic and integrated approach to solving problems and promoting development in the southern border provinces, including safety, intelligence operations, justice, fair assistance, prohibition of illegal acts, area development, career skills, and support for joint activities under a strong multicultural society.

program_name: Strategic Program on Management of Problems of Alien Workforce and Human Trafficking
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to resolve the security problems associated with human trafficking. It seeks to provide systematic protection and assistance to victims of trafficking, child labor, forced labor, and vulnerable groups, and to prevent and combat human trafficking using rights, freedom, and human rights mechanisms.

program_name: Integrated Program on Prevention, Suppression and Treatment of Drug Addiction
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to address drug issues so they no longer impact national administration and development. It includes creating a protective environment for children, youth, workers, and at-risk populations, organizing mechanisms to prevent and solve problems systematically, suppressing producers and traffickers, strengthening international cooperation, and providing treatment, rehabilitation, reconditioning, and follow-up assistance for drug addicts.

program_name: Strategic Program on Preventing and Rectifying Problems with Repercussions to the Security
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to address security-related issues so they do not affect the country's administration and development. This includes maintaining internal security, protecting interests relating to natural resources and the environment on land and at sea, ensuring cybersecurity, securing border areas, combating transnational crime and terrorism, providing maritime security, enhancing nuclear and radiation safety, and improving surveillance, response, and crime suppression.

program_name: Strategic Program on Developing National Preparedness System and Disaster Management System
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to build public confidence in emergency and rescue operations, minimize loss, and ensure safety in citizens' lives and properties. Efforts will focus on developing and improving policies and management to cover all types of disasters, preparing for disaster relief and emergency response, training personnel, developing an inclusive warning system, improving communication, increasing efficiency in solving disaster problems, and constructing dams to protect river banks.

program_name: Strategic Program on Developing National Defense Capacity and Preparedness in Coping with all Forms of Threats
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to ensure that security agencies are better prepared to face all types of threats in all dimensions. It aims to increase the efficiency of intelligence agencies and the intelligence community through strengthening and developing the national defense system, enhancing cooperation and resource pooling from all sectors, emphasizing the armed forces' capacity in national development and public assistance, and promoting the military defense and energy industry along with research and development for defense technology.

program_name: Strategic Program on Developing a Holistic Security Administration Mechanism
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to enhance the efficiency of security management mechanisms. The National Security Policy and Plan will be driven by developing a holistic security management mechanism.

program_name: Strategic Program on Promoting International Relations
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to unify Thailand's foreign affairs to achieve national security, prosperity, sustainability, international standards, and prestige in the global community. Focus will be on safeguarding national interests, promoting Thailand's role in Asia and ASEAN, supporting sustainable development, military relations, trade competitiveness, free-trade areas, and cooperation in science, technology, and innovation.

source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to ensure efficient and cost-effective administration of national security missions and enable government agencies to continuously perform and provide services according to their legal mandate and standards. It also supports taking good care of personnel, workplaces, equipment, and the work environment.

source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to ensure efficiency and cost effectiveness in the management of public sector personnel. In addition, there will be development of the government agencies' work system and personnel competencies so they can perform their duties with efficiency, morality and ethics while maintaining work-life balance.

source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025

program_name: Strategic Program on Value Creation Agriculture
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to increase the growth of the agricultural sector's GDP and enhance agricultural productivity and transform it into high-value downstream products by using technology to strengthen and sustain agricultural resources. The program promotes research, development, safety standards, organic farming, conservation of agricultural biological resources, value addition, integrated production management, new-generation farmers, and stronger farmer groups to generate income and improve quality of life.

program_name: Integrated Program on Development of Future Industries and Services
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to increase the growth rate of GDP in the industrial and service sectors and enhance productivity in these sectors. It promotes bio-industry, entrepreneurs and high-tech labor, comprehensive medical services, research and innovation in digital, data and artificial intelligence, transportation industry transition, technology transfer, joint ventures, industrial zones, workforce development, skilled labor import, advanced technology investment, and security industries with economic potential.

program_name: Strategic Program on Promoting and Developing Tourism Potential
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to elevate Thailand's tourism competitiveness, increase the tourism sector's contribution to GDP, and boost tourism revenue in secondary cities. This involves developing the tourism ecosystem, enhancing safety standards, restoring natural tourist attractions, developing infrastructure, preparing communities and personnel, promoting Thailand's tourism image and soft power, and positioning Thailand as a destination for conferences, trade shows, and international events.

program_name: Integrated Program on Creating Income from Tourism
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to increase the contribution of the tourism sector to GDP, enhance tourism revenue in secondary cities, and improve Thailand's tourism competitiveness. It focuses on spreading tourism activities and income to local communities, developing sustainable, health, creative and cultural tourism, preserving Thai identity, supporting international standards in tourist destinations and establishments, valuing the environment, ensuring tourist safety, and combating corruption and unfair practices in the tourism sector.

program_name: Strategic Program on Area Development and Smart Livable City
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to enhance Thailand's competitiveness and create centers of economic and social prosperity in every region of the country. This will be achieved by developing transportation, communication, and energy systems using modern digital technology, distributing prosperity, ensuring ecological zoning plans, stabilizing rural living conditions, promoting sustainable agriculture and eco-industries, conserving natural resources and cultural identity, and creating urban development databases.

program_name: Integrated Program on Development of Transport and Logistics System
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to provide Thailand with an efficient transportation and logistics system to reduce logistics costs and enhance competitiveness. It includes developing transportation infrastructure across road, water, rail, and air, multimodal facilities, public transport systems, logistics and supply chain management, trade facilitation, customs procedures, electronic data linkage, and the capabilities of logistics service providers and international transport networks.

program_name: Strategic Program on Improvement of Transportation Efficiency
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to provide Thailand with modern and efficient transportation systems and facilities. This will be achieved through the development, improvement, and maintenance of transportation infrastructure across road, water, rail, and air, development of facilities to support multimodal transportation, improved access to public transportation, and the production and oversight of transportation personnel.

program_name: Strategic Program on Development of Energy Security
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to enable Thailand to have energy security and improve efficiency in the country's energy consumption. This will be achieved by promoting and developing factors for energy procurement and infrastructure, supporting technology for energy management, promoting renewable and alternative energy, improving energy efficiency across all sectors, encouraging behavior change, supporting fair competition in the energy market, restructuring energy prices, and improving laws and regulations related to new energy technologies and business models.

program_name: Strategic Program on Development of Digital Economy and Society
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The strategic plan aims to increase the value of digital businesses in relation to GDP and expand the domestic digital economy. It will do so by developing nationwide digital infrastructure, promoting investment and shared use of digital infrastructure resources, developing international-standard digital infrastructure and data centers, updating laws, protecting personal rights and data, implementing cyber threat measures, and promoting education and skill enhancement in technology.

program_name: Strategic Program on Supporting Strong and Competitive Small and Medium-sized Enterprises
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to transform entrepreneurs at all levels into modern entrepreneurs who play a significant role in the economy. The program seeks to strengthen SME and community entrepreneurs through innovation, digital technology, market access, capital funding, financial products, export promotion, distribution centers, market knowledge, investment in research and innovation, technology transfer, public-private collaboration, job creation, and income opportunities for communities nationwide.

program_name: Strategic Program on Development of Special Economic Zones
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to develop the special economic zones as centers of economic and social prosperity by providing infrastructure in transportation, social, environment and education, and increasing the efficiency of customs checkpoints and updating or proposing laws and regulations. Attention will also be given to publicizing targeted areas to investors, improving public health at border areas, preventing communicable diseases, developing labor skills, organizing foreign workers systems, and preparing border areas for connected economic and social activities through digital technology and innovation.

program_name: Integrated Program on Development of the Eastern Economic Corridor
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to promote the growth of the gross regional product and increase investment in the Eastern Economic Corridor. The program encourages the development of modern, environmentally friendly economic activities, efficient and connected infrastructure and public utilities, livable and modern cities, improved quality of life for residents, and a stronger role for Thailand as a gateway to Asia in the global context.

program_name: Strategic Program on Innovation Research and Development
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to enhance the country's competitiveness in technology and scientific infrastructure and increase the value of research and innovation investment in relation to GDP. The actions include emphasizing research and innovation that meet national needs, promoting the private sector's role and collaboration with educational institutions, developing internationally recognized standards and testing services, addressing the digital era and aging society, developing highly skilled labor, conserving biodiversity, managing pollution and greenhouse gases, and improving research management systems for practical application.

program_name: Strategic Program on Development of Science, Technology and Innovation Potentials
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to increase the number of modern science and technology infrastructures necessary for the country's development. The program focuses on developing modern infrastructure and facilities, internationally recognized quality and testing systems, technology and innovation transfer, engineering design, process and product development through consortium operations, production and development of science and technology personnel, and collaboration among researchers, educational institutions, research institutes, and government agencies.

program_name: Strategic Program on Supporting the Development of Competitiveness
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to support the strategic goal of developing the country's competitiveness so Thailand becomes a developed country with stable and sustainable economic growth. This will be achieved by elevating the country's potential in the economy, identity, culture, tradition, way of life, natural resources, and comparative advantages, integrating technology and innovation, developing infrastructure in transportation, logistics, science, technology, digital systems and environmental adjustments, enhancing entrepreneurs, creating new income and employment bases, expanding trade and investment opportunities, and improving people's well-being.

program_name: Fundamental Program on the Development of Competitiveness
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to ensure the efficiency and cost-effectiveness of the country's competitiveness enhancement missions and allow government agencies to operate and provide services continuously in line with their legal authority and standards. It also ensures that personnel, facilities, equipment, and working environments are well-maintained.

source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025

program_name: Strategic Program on Realignment of Value and Culture
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to instill in citizens good morals, ethics, values, and culture, fostering a public spirit and social responsibility. It encourages the integration of religious principles and the philosophy of sufficiency economy into daily life, the conservation and restoration of customs and traditions, and support for cultural heritage development to increase value and enhance Thailand's image internationally.

program_name: Strategic Program on Development of Human Potentials on a Life-Long Basis
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to ensure that individuals of all ages can develop to their full potential, and that families and communities are strong and secure. The program promotes well-being and age-appropriate development from pregnancy through early childhood, quality education and lifelong learning, workforce skills aligned with the labor market and modern technology, and occupational skills for the elderly so they can be self-reliant.

program_name: Strategic Program on Development of Education and Learning Quality
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to provide Thai people with quality education that meets standards. This will be achieved by developing curricula, learning models, and teaching methods for the 21st century, supporting digital technology and innovation, promoting students' potential based on aptitude and multiple intelligences, developing teachers and educational personnel, preparing highly skilled professionals for the labor market, and supporting quality schools to expand access and reduce educational inequality.

program_name: Strategic Program on Good Public Health Promotion
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to ensure that Thai people have good physical and mental health, with access to standard, comprehensive, and efficient public health services. The program promotes training and distribution of medical personnel, development of modern healthcare services and tools, mental health care systems, emergency medical and referral systems, village health volunteer capacity, and traditional Thai medicine, alternative medicine, and Thai herbs for medical benefits.

program_name: Strategic Program on Enhancing Sports Potentials
source_location: Table I-4 Budget Allocation Strategy and Program FY 2025
program_description: The amount will be allocated to ensure that Thai people have good health and to raise awareness of the benefits of exercise and basic sports. Emphasis will be made on promoting exercise, sports, and recreational activities among citizens of all ages, supporting sports and sport science personnel to align with international standards, empowering youth to excel as professional athletes, and supporting sports and recreation infrastructure, equipment, and venues.

program_name: Strategic Program on Supporting Human Potentials Development and Reinforcement
